test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GLEPK’ is written as 'DIBMH' and 'QRYHN' is written as 'NOVEK'. How will 'POTER’ be written, in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'GLEPK’ is written as 'DIBMH'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e13505a51dea88a80434396459f6ea14ba789fbedec6e447d428e9cf3351443.png] 

'QRYHN' is written as 'NOVEK'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f35aafc97b76395877f76e48ef24e2cf6ae33e326b6d14e986fb461ecd9473d2.png] 

Similarly, for 'POTER’

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03342fa7d2688ecfa9212d3ecb26d1503e7b80aa5eb496799ac007ccd61de7a1.png] 

So, 'POTER’ is written as **'MLQBO'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
